title: Zero-Energy Problems for Supersymmetric Hamiltonians on a Chain Are $\mathrm{QMA}_1$-Complete
summary: We determine the computational complexity of deciding whether a supersymmetric quantum system on a one-dimensional chain has a zero-energy ground state. We prove $\mathrm{QMA}_1$-completeness for two input models, formulated in terms of Hermitian and nilpotent supercharges, respectively. In the Hermitian model, both the supercharge terms and the Hamiltonian have bounded range on the chain; in the nilpotent model, this geometric restriction applies only to the Hamiltonian.
